# Notre-Dame de Paris Guide

An independent visitor's guide to Notre-Dame de Paris and the Île de la Cité, and home of the TouringBee self-guided audio tour of the cathedral.

## About the audio tour
The TouringBee Notre-Dame de Paris audio tour covers the cathedral inside and out and the surrounding island. It has 31 stops, runs about 2 hours, works fully offline with a GPS map, is available in 10 languages, and runs on iOS and Android. One payment from €9.99, with one year of access.

## Key facts
- Notre-Dame de Paris reopened on 8 December 2024, five years after the 2019 fire.
- Entry to the cathedral is free; a free timed reservation is recommended at busy times.
- The towers, the Archaeological Crypt and the Treasury are separate, paid visits.
